scope: Nine new edible flavor descriptions and three shared psychedelic descriptions; labels and gameplay values retained. Cauliflower and PurpleBlewit retain their already approved descriptions.

BlackTruffle.ko: 트러플을 먹었어. 짙고 독특한 향이 입안 가득 퍼져서 좋았지.
BlackTruffle.en: I ate some black truffle. I loved its rich, distinctive aroma.

Porcini.ko: 포르치니를 먹었어. 두툼한 살에 은은하게 고소한 맛이 나서 좋았지.
Porcini.en: I ate some porcini. I liked their thick flesh and gently nutty flavor.

Morel.ko: 곰보버섯을 먹었어. 순한 맛에 탄력 있게 씹히는 식감도 좋았지.
Morel.en: I ate some morels. I liked their mild flavor and springy bite.

BlackTrumpet.ko: 블랙트럼펫을 먹었어. 얇은 살에 진한 버섯 맛이 담겨 있어 좋았지.
BlackTrumpet.en: I ate some black trumpets. I liked their thin flesh and rich mushroom flavor.

GiantPuffball.ko: 댕구알버섯을 먹었어. 푹신하고 부드러운 속살에 은은한 버섯 맛까지 좋았지.
GiantPuffball.en: I ate some giant puffball. Its soft, fluffy flesh and gentle mushroom flavor were lovely.

IndigoMilkcap.ko: 파란젖버섯을 먹었어. 짙은 흙내음이 감도는 버섯 맛이 좋았지.
IndigoMilkcap.en: I ate some indigo milkcap. I liked its deep, earthy mushroom flavor.

VeiledStinkhorn.ko: 망태버섯을 먹었어. 부드럽게 씹히다가 살짝 아삭한 식감이 좋았지.
VeiledStinkhorn.en: I ate some veiled stinkhorn. Its smooth texture and light crunch were lovely.

ShaggyInkcap.ko: 먹물버섯을 먹었어. 부드러운 식감에 섬세한 버섯 풍미까지 좋았지.
ShaggyInkcap.en: I ate some shaggy inkcap. Its delicate texture and gentle mushroom flavor were lovely.

Lobster.ko: 랍스터버섯을 먹었어. 단단하고 도톰한 살을 씹는 맛이 좋았지.
Lobster.en: I ate some lobster mushroom. Its thick, firm flesh made a satisfying bite.

0.ko: 버섯을 먹었어. 색이 선명해지고 무늬가 일렁이는 게 신기했지.
0.en: I ate some mushrooms. The vivid colors and rippling patterns were fascinating.

1.ko: 버섯을 먹었어. 꿈속에 있는 것처럼 몽롱해서 한동안 멍하니 있었지.
1.en: I ate some mushrooms. I felt like I was in a dream, lost in a daze for a while.

2.ko: 버섯을 먹었어. 익숙한 곳마저 낯설고 무서워서 이 느낌이 빨리 끝났으면 좋겠어.
2.en: I ate some mushrooms. Even familiar places feel strange and frightening, and I want this feeling to end.
